// note: Project-scoped Claude Code settings for Tessera. Permissions pre-approve safe, frequent operations and deny destructive ones. Hooks validate at submit time, never mid-edit. Adapt command paths to your environment.

PostToolUse.// note: Auto-format after edits. Non-blocking (always exits 0): format, never veto, so Claude's reasoning chain is not interrupted mid-task.

PreToolUse.// note: Guardrail against destructive shell commands. Exit code 2 denies the call.

hooks.command: grep -Eq 'rm -rf (/|~|\$HOME)|git push (--force|-f)|:\s*\(\)\s*\{' && { echo 'Blocked: destructive command pattern.' >&2; exit 2; } || exit 0

Stop.// note: Reminder to wrap the session. Non-blocking.

hooks.command: echo 'Session ending — consider running /wrap to update docs/STATUS.md.' ; exit 0
